table.name: TLGNR_PACKAGE_TYPE_BS
table.description: The package types that LOGON can handle to LOAD differently, i.e. this mainly characterizes the loadingpoint. Only packaging types which are relevent for loading are distinguished: A Silo (for 'Silosteller' is not loaded with Logon, but the material in it may be loaded, but that is normal 'bulk'.

column.name: PACKAGE_TYPE_CD
column.description: PK. Code of the Reference Data. 1=Bulk, 2=Bag.

column.name: CTL_ACT_CD
column.description: Active Flag. When new data is entered, only reference data with active flag are available for selection normally.
